summary: 2026-27 home jersey (navy/light blue, circular crest). Placement list from the club's own current-season match photo gallery (home v Ak Bars 24-09-2026, /media/photo/24-09-2026-sibir-ak-bars/): Novosibirskenergosbyt along the lower front, 'Новосибирская область' lower-back patch, WINLINE on both sleeves, S7 roundel on both shoulders, league marks — 'МИР' chest patch, 'ФОНБЕТ КХЛ' collar patch, 'СОГАЗ' helmet decal. No sponsor logos seen on the pants (club crest + Bauer maker marks only). sponsorsComplete is false: there is no text-based kit launch naming every placement; the list is photo-verified. Off-jersey partners (Veka, Atributika & Club, Zapaska, Novosibirskaya Ptitsefabrika, Ulanta, Yandex Eda, Sport 24) per the club's founders-and-partners page.
